name: km-plugin-registry
description: KM Plugin Registry - A community registry of plugins

plugins.name: frontend-scaffold
plugins.description: Scaffold production-grade Vue 3 frontend applications with shadcn/ui patterns, Pinia stores, and typed API client

plugins.name: feature-dev-documentalist
plugins.description: Auto-document feature development phases from git diff — spec, architecture, implementation, deployment, and testing

plugins.name: gitbook-docs-validator
plugins.description: Validate GitBook/mdBook docs against the three-book template (landing page, user, operator, tester guides) and report missing pages, broken links and deviations

plugins.name: implementation-spec
plugins.description: Write implementation-ready feature specs — explored from the codebase, interviewed once, and audited so an orchestrator agent can build the whole thing with no further input

plugins.name: memors-hooks
plugins.description: Hooks that run the memors-mcp knowledge-base loop for the agent — orient at session start, flag already-stored sources, nudge to record findings, and keep trust changes human-only

plugins.name: rigorous-review
plugins.description: A strict, pre-merge code review skill that hunts for logic bugs, concurrency issues, security holes, performance traps and over-engineering, and reports each with a minimal fix

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat showing the current plan and how far its realisation has advanced (tasks, todos, plan checkboxes, steps the model marks)

plugins.name: session-cost
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat listing every model request with its tokens and cost (ledger share and price estimate), with session totals and history

plugins.name: prompt-coach
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat that collects the prompts you type, shows a language correction for each, and has a practice game built from your own mistakes
